latHint: Think beating a rival at their game - not a suit.
pivHint: A TRUMP is the winning suit in bridge - but to TRUMP a rival means to do what to them?
winText: Top that. TRUMP was the pivot - a winning suit to OUTDOing a rival.
lossText: OUTDO - to beat. TRUMP was the pivot: a bridge TRUMP to TRUMPing a rival.
